title: Of the notice starts, only the app's status block may lead a prompt whose last line is the override form.
ruling: Coordinator pick a, 08:21 CST Nov 12 (not an owner ruling): the last-line override route takes no judge and obeys the plain ask's gates; of the notice starts only the status block (STATUS_BLOCK_TAG) may lead the prompt, and any other notice start grants nothing, as on main.
